title: Northgate Cash Redemption and Expiry Terms
content:
Terms of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** for spending Northgate Cash: the smallest amount that can be applied, the channels that accept it, what it cannot pay for, when it expires and what happens to it when a membership closes.

| Tier | Smallest amount applied to a purchase (USD) | Redemption channels |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0.01 | in store, online, app |
| Northgate+ Assist | 0.01 | in store, online, app |
| Northgate+ Student | 0.01 | in store, online, app |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 0.01 | in store, online, app |
| Northgate+ Annual | 0.01 | in store, online, app |
| Northgate+ Business | 10.00 | online, app |

**Terms common to every tier**

- Northgate Cash cannot pay for gift cards, membership fees or card payments.
- Unredeemed Northgate Cash from one earning expires 12 calendar months after the earn date of that earning.
- The Northgate Cash balance is not forfeited when the membership closes.

**Questions and answers**

*Can a Northgate+ Business member apply Northgate Cash at a store register?* No. The Business redemption channels are online and the app only, and the smallest amount the Business tier applies is 10.00.

*Can Cash be put toward a Northgate Card payment?* No. Card payments are among the purchase types Northgate Cash cannot pay for, on every tier.

*Hypothetical expiry date:* an earning booked on 12 March expires 12 calendar months after that earn date, on 12 March of the following year.
